image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a vintage audio cassette tape. The casing is black plastic with a white paper label on the top face featuring red handwritten text and some printed black text. Two circular windows reveal the white spools inside, connected by dark magnetic tape. A rectangular opening at the bottom exposes the tape path. There are visible signs of wear, including scuffs on the plastic and creases on the label.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The red handwritten text on the label is stylized and largely illegible, resembling scribbles rather than coherent characters. While this could be artistic graffiti, AI generators often struggle with legible handwriting, making this a potential artifact of text generation failure.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom left corner of the cassette body
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a slight smudging or 'melting' appearance where the black plastic meets the background/shadow area, lacking the sharp edge definition expected of rigid plastic.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a cassette and not a similar rectangular object.
To analyze the legibility and structure of the red handwritten text on the label to determine if it is gibberish.
To verify the structural integrity of the plastic casing and ensure no parts are fused or floating, especially around the spool windows.
To assess general image quality, noise, and any subtle generative artifacts not caught by specific audits.

focus_areas: Legibility and coherence of the handwritten text on the label.
Structural correctness of the spool mechanism and tape path.
Edge sharpness and boundary definition of the plastic casing against the background.
Consistency of lighting and reflections on the plastic surface.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text auditor's output regarding the red handwriting. If the text is completely nonsensical or structurally impossible (e.g., letters merging into each other), increase the artifact severity. Also, verify if the topology auditor finds any issues with the connection between the spools and the tape, as this is a common failure point in AI-generated cassettes.
